name: Paperspace vs raw cloud GPU pricing - Dedicated GPU rates vs market
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Paperspace dedicated GPU rates vs raw cloud providers: A100-80G $1.15/hr (Paperspace) vs CoreWeave A100 $2.70/GPU-hr vs AWS p4d $4.10/GPU-hr vs Replicate A100 $5.04/hr. H100 $3.09/hr (Paperspace) vs CoreWeave H100 $6.16/GPU-hr vs Together H100 $3.99/GPU-hr vs Beam H100 $1.83/hr. A4000 $0.76/hr, A6000 $1.89/hr, V100 $2.30/hr, A5000 $1.38/hr, P6000 $1.10/hr, RTX5000 $0.82/hr, RTX4000 $0.56/hr, P4000 $0.51/hr, M4000 $0.45/hr. Paperspace's A100-80G at $1.15/hr is the cheapest published A100 rate we've found from any managed provider, but it is the PCIe variant (not SXM) and the 'A100-80G' naming is ambiguous. The H100 at $3.09/hr is competitive with Together's GPU Clusters rate. Paperspace includes vCPU and RAM in the rate. The Gradient platform adds a monthly fee ($0-$39/month) on top of compute. Auto-shutdown is enforced (12h limit on Free, configurable on paid tiers). Paperspace was acquired by DigitalOcean, which may affect future pricing and availability.
